messages:
Maya (docs): I opened a compact PR to tighten up Dedicated provisioning docs: short terraform and SDK examples, clear autoscale defaults, and a short migration checklist. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5012
Diego (infra): Nice start. Please split examples: reserved (no-evict), spot (preemptible), and hybrid (reserved + burst). Call out eviction semantics clearly.
Hana (eng-runtime): From load tests, recommend target_cpu=60 for production (stable tails). Include a cost-optimized example with 55 and a note about oscillation.
Maya (docs): Will do. Draft terraform sample in PR:
```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "customer" {
  region = "us-west1"
  accelerator = "a10g"
  size = 4
  autoscale = {
    min = 2
    max = 8
    target_cpu = 60
    burst_enabled = true
  }
  eviction_strategy = "none"
}
```
Diego (infra): Rename eviction_strategy values in the docs to map to provider: "none" / "preemptible". Add `eviction_notice_window` note for spot.
Ravi (solutions): For migration checklist add: copy model routing, verify IAM & VPC, run smoke test, and set up fallback route. I'll add Node + Python SDK snippets.
Maya (docs): Draft SDK snippets in PR—please confirm method names:
Node:
```js
const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.reservations.create({ region: 'us-west1', accelerator: 'a10g', count: 4 });
```
Python:
```py
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=os.environ['RW_KEY'])
c.reservations.create(region='us-west1', accelerator='a10g', count=4)
```
Hana (eng-runtime): Those map to our SDK. Add mapping note: quickstart verbs -> canonical `client.reservations.create`. Also add sample log check: `grep -i evict /var/log/redwood/runtime.log` and metric: `evictions_total{pool="customer"}`.
Olga (legal): Please use: "SLA-backed for qualifying Dedicated contracts; performance may be affected during maintenance or major incidents." Avoid absolutes.
link-bot: link-checker: broken -> /dedicated/old-ops (docs/dedicated/provisioning.md line 9).
Maya (docs): Removing legacy link. Will merge once link-bot is green and Olga signs off on SLA text. After merge I'll open a follow-up for an internal oncall playbook with escalation steps. :white_check_mark:
